title: Irish Seared Potatoes with Crispy Wrap
description: A delicious and easy to make recipe featuring seared Irish potatoes wrapped in a crispy pan-fried wrap.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add the Irish potatoes to the pan and sear for 4-5 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
In a separate pan, heat a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Place the wrap in the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy.
Serve the seared potatoes wrapped in the crispy wrap.
